name: Group-wise Projection Release
definition: Processes projection in 3x3 groups with a 128 MiB Leaf budget to further reduce memory, releasing projection group-wise.
summary: Group-wise Projection Release is a memory optimization for 3D Gaussian Splatting that reduces peak memory by processing and immediately releasing 3x3 projection groups, distinguishing itself from Williams Distributed Projection through fine-grained release.
